Day 3 of PyCon Africa 2026 and we went from hospital records to a working API. 🐍🏥

Ernest Essien spoke on “From Hospital Records to REST API: Training and Serving XGBoost Disease Prediction Models in Python,” covering EpiScope: 13,000+ patient records from a Ghanaian health facility, XGBoost, SHAP, and a Django REST Framework API.

His first model hit 100% accuracy. Then he found the leak. Open-source and worth a look.

Thank you, Ernest! 🙌

#PyConAfrica2026 #PyConAfrica #Python #MachineLearning
